Food

What comes out of the kitchen

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Lahmajoun

Flatbread with minced meat, baked in the wood oven. 60 reviews mention it, and guests like watching the pastries being made through the window.

Pies from the oven

Halloumi pie, khachapuri, spinach and potato pies. 31 reviews mention the halloumi pie, 13 the khachapuri.

From the grill

Lamb and pork souvlaki, chicken BBQ, sheftalia, kebab and mixed grill, with grilled pitta.

Falafel and koupes

Falafel and koupes. 27 reviews mention the falafel, 8 the koupes.

From the oven and the grill

Photos from the Google listing of Avo Armenian Food.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Street food

34 reviews call it street food: tables on the pavement in the old town, a quick bite between walks.

Fair prices

Many reviews call the food affordable or cheap for the portion, and the service quick.

Fresh and warm

Guests describe the pies as fresh and warm; one review says the meat is cooked fresh on the charcoal grill.

An oven in the old town

Avo is at Onasagorou 22, in the old town of Nicosia, close to Ledra Street. The logo says Armenian food since 2009. Through the window you can watch the dough go into the wood oven, and outside a few tables stand on the pavement. Open every day from 8:00 to 22:00.

What guests say

Three of 1,206 Google reviews, 867 of them with five stars.
